name: Quality HVAC by Fibid
verdict: Google Ads drove all $1,698.97 in spend over 28 days with 16 conversions, but GBP engagement dropped sharply by 51.61% week-over-week, likely signaling reduced local search visibility or seasonal demand softening that is cutting top-of-funnel activity before it reaches the site.

performance.verdict: Spend is live but zero tracked leads in 45 days — attribution is broken, not demand.

findings.text: 28-day leads = 0 and 45-day series shows all-zero leads daily despite $1,698.97 Google spend — conversion tracking is broken, not demand.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and shows no completed event — CRM automation is unvalidated while intake seat is also vacant since 7/7.
GHL returned a 401 timeout error — pipeline data is unavailable, so intake leak vs. ads failure cannot be distinguished this cycle.
GBP actions dropped 51.61% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 14–16) show 5, 0, 0 — a 3-day confirmed stall after a 5-action day, not noise.
Google spend is erratic: 28 of 45 days show spend ≤ $20 or $0, suggesting campaign pacing or budget cap issues rather than a steady $43/day.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair Google Ads conversion tracking — 45 days, $1,698.97 spent, zero recorded leads is a confirmed pixel/tag failure.
suggestions.monday_update: Conversion tracking has recorded zero leads across all 45 days in the series despite $1,698.97 in Google Ads spend — this is a confirmed tag or pixel failure, not a demand problem. Action: pull Google Tag Assistant and Ads conversion action audit this week; verify that the call/form conversion events are firing on the confirmation page or via call extension. Success check: at least one conversion event confirmed firing in Tag Assistant and appearing in Ads UI by 2026-08-20. Do not raise any budgets until tracking is confirmed clean.

suggestions.text: Resolve GHL 401 timeout and confirm live intake owner — dispatch seat vacant since 7/7 blocks speed-to-lead and the scale-back-up gate.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL is returning a 401 timeout error, making pipeline data completely unavailable, and the dispatch seat (Vivian) has been vacant since 7/7 with no confirmed replacement on record. Action: restore GHL API auth this week and get a named replacement for Vivian with a confirmed GHL login and after-hours coverage plan. Success check: GHL pipeline data pulls cleanly in next performance run and intake owner is documented in the WhatsApp group by 2026-08-22. This is a SOW blocker — budgets cannot scale until both are resolved per the engagement plan.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions through 2026-08-20 — 3-day stall (0 actions Aug 14–16) may deepen; no paid lever available until tracking is fixed.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have stalled to zero for the last 3 days (Aug 14–16) after a -51.61% week-over-week drop — this is a confirmed short-term signal, not noise. No paid action is warranted until Google conversion tracking is repaired (S1). Monitor GBP actions daily; if the stall extends beyond 5 consecutive days, investigate listing health (suppression, duplicate flags) and consider a GBP post or Q&A refresh. Re-check on 2026-08-20.
